method: Select target position using goal one-hot after recovering physical units; feed robot state, relative target/hand/bin geometry and target/bin positions to same MLP. Non-target positions and color identity are discarded after target selection. No scripted controller or action clipping at inference. Input normalization and feature mode stored in checkpoint buffers.
selection: Lowest validation MSE within 100 epochs; one goal-relative training run, then development/official/holdout evaluation. No per-scene tuning.
checks: legacy flat checkpoint produces identical outputs
color permutation with same target has invariant features
synthetic representation unit checks; actual simulator development and held-out rollouts
train_command: .venv/bin/python scripts/train.py --policy multitask --goal-relative --zarr datasets/processed/multi_cube/ex3_initial60.zarr --state-keys state_ee_xyz state_gripper "state_joints[:5]" "original_pos_cube_red[:3]" "original_pos_cube_green[:3]" "original_pos_cube_blue[:3]" state_goal goal_pos --action-keys action_ee_xyz action_gripper --chunk-size 4 --d-model 512 --depth 3 --threads 2 --epochs 100 --output checkpoints/multi_cube/ex3_relative60.pt
